attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production location reference key for an original action webtoon. Single landscape image, precisely 1536 x 1024 pixels, PNG. Establishing environment, full architectural detail. Camera on a side gallery about 10 m above the ground, 24 mm wide view, looking gently down and across a five-storey 15 m tall glass atrium at 9 AM. Show the entire grey-and-white geometric tile floor and its large inlaid STAR INSIDE A SHIELD Association emblem, one simple five-point star enclosed by a shield silhouette, with no lettering. The emblem is an inlay lying FLAT on the ground plane in perspective, not a standing sign. Tall slender grey structural columns, glass curtain walls, a visible glass roof with a clean regular mullion grid, pale upper circulation galleries. Morning daylight through that glass roof is the named key light, visible clean sky and roof, creating broad cool hard-edged cel shadow shapes on the floor. White and slate architectural palette. Three large wall-mounted rectangular display screens face the atrium at coherent heights; every screen face is a perfectly flat uniform unshaded exact RGB (0,255,0), hexadecimal #00FF00, crisp black bezels. No display content or reflected light, no gradient inside the green screen faces. On the lower-left entry route, a human-sized security arch with opening exactly 2.2 m high next to a simple grey security desk 0.9 m tall, with a regular 2.1 m door nearby as scale anchors. Only TWO tiny generic adult grey-uniformed staff for scale, about 1.75 m tall, long-legged 7.5 head proportions; one mid-step beside the security arch holding a folder, the other deeper into the atrium looking toward a screen, hands behind the back. Their feet sit on the same floor perspective; they are small compared with 15 m columns. All other chairs and circulation floor empty. Keep the uppermost strip clean and quiet with pale roof panes. Drawn straight architectural edges, restrained reflections only on glass or smooth stone, crisp hand-inked flat shapes, no photographic textures. The attached approved location image is ONLY a V2 ink-and-cel rendering reference; create this entirely different morning atrium layout; do not copy its night setting, rectangular room or windows. Do not add a gate, construct, named character, crowd, text or signage.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
